title: Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros
versionRelation: Distinct companion manuscripts; no supersession inferred from dates.
checkingScope: 全証明本文pp.2–8の帰着・主張・入力を読解。全計算の独立検証ではない。

statements.hypotheses: Every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet character, conductor q>=3; every real zero beta in (0,1).
statements.conclusion: There exists an absolute c>0 with (1-beta)log q>=c. No numeric or effective c explicitly stated.

statements.hypotheses: Surjective A:C^4->C^3; ker A=Cc with four Q-independent coordinates; N>=1 and separate degree product condition (3.1).

proofPassages.read: Real zero retained in nonnegative zero sum; positive Euler coefficients; Mertens transition.
Dimension count; nearest lattice point; supporting face; rational hyperplane and Lagrange selection; aspect-ratio uniformity.
Biquadratic map and kernel, greedy row selection, degree-mass bounds and coefficient independence.
Frobenius congruence, triangular replacement over K, divisibility from entries, integer norm comparison.
Negation sequence; bounded-conductor nonvanishing; d=2 exclusion; H then gamma then limit; constants and error terms.

dependencies.checking: Publisher preview PDF p.2 gives any primitive character and sigma>1, nonnegative real parts of zero terms; t=0 specializes to required bound.

unresolved: No recursive independent proof verification of Davenport Hadamard product, Mertens/Chebyshev, or Dirichlet nonvanishing.
All auxiliary arithmetic and interpolation calculations were read, not formally or independently exhaustively verified.
